message.content:
| Language | Performance | Safety | Ecosystem | Learning Curve | Best For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Python** | Moderate | High (memory safety via GC) | Very Large | Low | Data Science, AI/ML, Scripting, Rapid Prototyping |
| **Rust** | Very High | Very High (memory safety without GC) | Growing | High | Systems Programming, High-Performance Tools, WebAssembly |
| **Go** | High | Moderate (no pointers, no GC pauses) | Large | Low | Cloud Services, Microservices, CLI Tools, DevOps |
